headline: Economic growth expected to improve in most states by 2027
summary: Projections point to stronger 2027 GDP growth in most Mexican states, led by Quintana Roo, Coahuila and Mexico City (CDMX). The outlook covers regional economic performance rather than national policy.
why: State-level GDP forecasts show where Mexican economic activity is expected to expand, informing investment, lending and regional expansion decisions. Mexico is a major manufacturing and trade partner for North America.
original_headline: Prevén mejora del crecimiento económico en la mayoría de los estados para 2027
